t2i_prompt: A 1440 px wide desktop website section as a flat straight-on UI mockup on a warm limestone background. A small eyebrow label and a hairline rule across the top, then a large light-weight navy sans headline in sentence case. Left half: one matte white polypropylene skid with translucent pale-blue water columns, soft 3D isometric render in even studio light, with numbered hairline leader-line callouts. Right half: a short lead paragraph and a three-column table with hairline rules for <CONTENT>, one value in steel blue. Square corners, generous space, calm.
signature_idea: One soft white PP skid floats on the limestone page as the product hero, while the grade question is answered in a plain ruled table beside it.
strengths: calm, uncluttered layout with lots of space
light navy headline and hairline table are on-brand
matte white PP and translucent water show the real material
table is legible with short, scannable cells
weaknesses: skid callouts are generic and do not relate to the table
duplicated callout label (04. Modular Skid twice)
columns look like filter housings, a lab demo rather than a PW skid
no mono for codes or figures
table side is a plain table with no visual link to the image
brand_fit_why: Limestone ground, navy light headline, hairline table and white PP render fit the brand, but the callouts are generic and mono figures are missing.
